VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The acceptance criteria requires objective verification that "the stale-quote eviction bug is fixed and all 64 tests pass." The agent's self-report claims this outcome but provides no independent evidence (CI logs, test results, diffs, or artifacts) to corroborate it. Self-reports alone cannot satisfy acceptance criteria that demand demonstrable proof of bug fixes and test passage, as they lack the independent verification necessary to confirm the claims made.
